terms.definition: Replaceable implementation of a public port; owns mechanics, never domain meaning.
Named, bounded ability requiring an explicit owner and grant route.
Bounded state with exact sources, proof results, limits, and a next gate.
Requested state-changing operation with authority, idempotency, input, output, and typed failure.
Immutable notification of a committed fact with sequence and correlation identity.
Versioned optional contract point admitted by a named owner without private-boundary access.
Stable machine identity governed by one grammar and namespace owner.
Ordered, reversible-or-bounded transformation between declared schema versions.
One semantic owner composed through manifests, public ports, operations, state, lifecycle, and proof.
Declarative allow, deny, or require rule evaluated with stable diagnostics.
Typed public dependency boundary owned by the domain that consumes it.
Rebuildable derived view that never replaces or mutates its source authority.
Read-only bounded observation with source and disclosure constraints.
Time- and scope-bounded execution evidence with inputs, checks, results, and non-proofs.
Versioned values with identity, owner, authority class, lifecycle, provenance, and digest.
Typed directed connection between stable record identities.
Legal movement between declared states with guard, effect, authority, and recovery.
Versioned composition of typed operations, transitions, gates, recovery, and receipts.
